title: Attention Is Not All You Need for Small Data

entities.name: Vaswani et al.
entities.context: Authors who introduced the transformer in 2017.

entities.name: GPT-4
entities.context: A large language model built on transformers.

concepts.name: Transformer architecture
concepts.description: Neural network architecture based on self-attention.

concepts.name: Two-layer LSTM
concepts.description: A small recurrent network used as the baseline.

claims.claim: A two-layer LSTM matches the transformer's accuracy on four of six benchmarks.
claims.quote: Our results show that a two-layer LSTM matches the transformer's accuracy on four of the six benchmarks, while training five times faster on a single GPU.

claims.claim: The study covers transformers trained on fewer than ten thousand examples.
claims.quote: We study transformer models trained on fewer than ten thousand examples.

claims.claim: The LSTM trained in 1.5 hours against 7.4 for the transformer.

relationships.description: Vaswani et al. introduced the transformer in 2017.
relationships.quote: The transformer architecture, introduced by Vaswani et al. in 2017, replaced recurrence with self-attention.

relationships.description: GPT-4 is built on the transformer.
relationships.quote: It is part of nearly every large language model in use today, including GPT-4.

relationships.description: The LSTM is an alternative to the transformer on small data.

summary: Small recurrent models can match transformers on small data sets.
